description: Search for AWS EC2 Spot Instance options based on requirements. Returns pricing, savings, and interruption data.

az.description: Request AZ-level scores instead of region-level (use with --with-score)

instance_types.description: Instance type pattern - exact type (e.g., 'm5.large') or pattern (e.g., 't3.*', 'm5.*')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

max_price_per_hour.description: Maximum spot price per hour in USD

regions.description: AWS regions to search (e.g., ['us-east-1', 'eu-west-1']). Use ['all'] or omit to search all regions

score_timeout.description: Timeout for score enrichment in seconds

sort_by.description: Sort results by: 'price' (cheapest first), 'reliability' (lowest interruption first), 'savings' (highest savings first), 'score' (highest score first)

name: find_spot_instances
